description: Na₂Mg(MoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.80 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MoO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MoO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.14 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to six O atoms to form MoO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with five equivalent MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.21 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MoO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent MoO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-54°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.26 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgMo₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgMo₂ square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MgMo₂ square pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two Mo atoms.
